notes.title: Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello! 

PiedPipers Team here.

We’re excited to introduce the new game mode for Plebby Quest called the “Land of Chaos”.  This new mode features 7 unique maps where the religions, empires and regions’ locations always appear randomly, so each time you play it is a completely different experience! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35393732/d9298c5a846b6b88b82a209fba7e8e47f485c494.gif

Not only that, but the Free Play mode has also been improved through Blessings and Hardships which will add a lot of variety to the gameplay.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35393732/76fb9cffc4be6ffa45d5f971cb21e2c48a208abb.gif

 And last but not least, the following bugs have been fixed and improvements made.

-Monastery & Policing Automatization, Research Location Changed
 - Fixed bug where in certain situations you could continuously get Outlaw Special Forces
 - Added the ability to denounce heresy at the religious conference
 - Added Steam Achievements (New Mode & Blessings/Hardships)
 - Misc. bug fixes

However like we stated in a previous post, this update will not affect your stats regarding ‘game completions’ or anything that you’ve unlocked, but it will NOT work with previous save files. So if you have any games that are currently in-progress, you unfortunately will not be able to finish them.

This is something we’ve been talking about since launch, so we’re sorry that it took so long to share this content with you. We’ll keep trying our hardest to make the best possible version of Plebby Quest that we can and hope that it creates a lot of good gaming memories for you. 

We also hope that you have a great end to the year. See you again soon!

 - PiedPipers Team

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35393732/a521b990d357478f66643ba19c7bad0158d133f6.png

notes.title: Update- Advance Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello,

PiedPipers Team here!

We’re almost done with the next update and are on-track to release it on December 18th. 

There are a couple important things that we need to share with you beforehand though.

The next patch will mainly consist of the following two items.


 Altering the Chest System
 Adding a new mode


Please note that this update will NOT work with your currently-saved games and you won’t be able to complete them after installing the patch. This will not adversely affect your number of ‘game completions’ or unlocked features though.

This update was a major undertaking for our development team and the above situation was unavoidable, so we hope that you can understand and have enough time to finish all of your games that are currently in-progress.

That being said, we really hope that you enjoy the new contents!

- PiedPipers Team-

notes.title: Update Schedule Change
notes.notes:
Hello, 

PiedPipers Team here.

First of all, thank you once again for playing our game. We really appreciate it.

Unfortunately, we’ve decided to push back our next update. We had planned on releasing a new patch and DLC this year, but after reviewing your feedback have come to the conclusion that we need more time.

Please accept our sincere apology for this sudden and unexpected delay.

That being said, if all goes according to plan our next update will go live in December and the DLC will follow in February.

Both the new update and DLC will provide tons of new content, the key parts of which are listed below.

[Update- December]
New Mode

[DLC- February]
2 New Scenarios

Please just keep in mind that we’re delaying the release of all this to provide the highest-quality experience that we can. We promise that the wait will be worth it!

notes.title: Patch Notes (1.55 ver.)
notes.notes:
Hello Again!

We’re pleased to finally welcome the German and Chinese-speaking communities to Plebby Quest. You can now enjoy it in your native languages!

The main goal of this patch was to provide a lot of ‘quality of life’ improvements that would make for a more satisfying gaming experience. We’re just sorry that we couldn’t deliver these changes even earlier or during the initial launch. Rest assured that we’ll continue to improve the game to the best of our ability going forward though!

However please keep in mind that this update will NOT allow you to finish any games that are currently in progress (your overall save data regarding game completions and unlocked features will not be adversely affected though).

The key features of this update are as follows:


Additional Language Support
- German, Chinese (Simplified & Traditional)

New Ruins Added
- Added new Ruins, Generals & Troops that are inspired by German and Chinese culture
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35393732/36b2096a613dd703679003d25f6be024fbea7cc5.gif


Improved Autobot
- Made a Monastery Bot : The Bot will take care of praying, cataloging books and producing luxuries.
- Combined pre-existing autobots (wall repair, patrol, etc) to create Public Order Bot
- In case you assign the Public Order Bot to suppress armed rabble, a General that will undoubtedly win will be chosen and the battle will proceed automatically.

Improved Coin Mini-game
- Changed Religious Conference persuasion to work the same as conversations in the Inn.
- No longer done in mid to late game thanks to Monastery Bot

Optimized Battle Speed
- Sped up auto battles

Miscellaneous
- Adjusted time when rivals/allies appear
- Changed frequency of acquiring empire-specific troops to 1 (Including allies & captors)
- Improved UI for Currency Mini-game
-  Fixed it so that Celtic Longbowman will not be detected when sending a volley in Ruins.
- Added Diplomatic & Religious Relation Points
- Minor balancing changes

Final Warning
- Currently in-progress games will not work with this update.

notes.title: Update- Advance Announcement
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35393732/2aba1912e016c554b6fccb3ff201f72393f086be.png

Hello,

PiedPipers Team here!
 
We just wanted to let you know that we’re putting the finishing touches on the update we mentioned in the Development Roadmap. We still have a few more bugs to iron out, but are hoping to release it on August 26th if all goes well.
 
There’s also an important announcement we need to make, but first please take a look at the key aspects of this update.


 Additional Language Support
     - German, Chinese (Simplified & Traditional)
 New Ruins Added
     - Adding new ruins, generals & troops that are based on German and Chinese culture
 Balancing & Improvements
     - Improved Autobot
     - Overhauled coin mini-game
     - Optimized battle speed

 
 
Please be aware that this update will NOT allow you to finish any games that are currently in progess (your overall save data regarding game completions and unlocked features will not be adversely affected though).
 
We had to change a wide range of contents for this update, so we hope you can be understanding of this situation. With that being said, please make sure to finish any games you’re currently playing before the update comes out!
 
Thank you once again for your understanding and support of Plebby Quest. We really appreciate it!
 
- PiedPipers Team-

notes.title: Patch Notes (1.51 ver.)
notes.notes:
Here’s our 1.51 ver. patch notes.

 Save / Load UI has been improved.
 Parliament UI has been improved.
 The effect of Infantry class ability (Good Quality Armor) has increased. (DP+1 -> DP+2)
 If an attack to enemy capital succeeded, the attack on other non-capital cities will not be cancelled anymore.
 Marking numbers of strategic resources has been improved. (3 digits -> 4 digits)
 Marked tier of troops' detailed statistics (number of stars) has been adjusted.
 The damages of ranged skills (fire, etc.) on walls and siege weapon has decreased to half.
 Etc. small bugs are fixed.



We're preparing extra translations on some languages. More people will be able to enjoy in much familiar words. Thanks.

 - PiedPipers Team.

notes.title: Patch Notes (1.50 ver.)
notes.notes:
Here’s our 1.50 ver. patch notes.


 Auto-battle speed optimization.
 AI turn speed optimization.
 Auto-save timing has changed (to starting player's turn).
 Problem of using only one symbol in uprising kingdoms is fixed.
 Problem of watchtower not responding to charging cavalry is fixed.
 Message in Ruin is reduced, when you play several times.
 Etc. small bugs are fixed.
 Client Optimization.


 Our further modification plans are written in Discussions. Thanks.

 - PiedPipers Team.

notes.title: Patch Notes (1.49 ver.)
notes.notes:
Here’s our 1.49 ver. patch notes.


 Reward of Strange Adventures have heavily increased.
 Auto-Battle is now available in the battles with armed rabbles.
 Allies don't announce blaming agenda in Council anymore.
 Auto-Charge function is now set OFF basically.
 Growth of AI is controlled in Game of Prince.   (Applied in New games)
 Troops in kingdom's reserves are now sorted. (Tier -> Class -> MAX_HP)   (Applied in New games)
 Roads connected to outlaws are added.   (Applied in New games)
 Required EXP for 1Lv general has decreased.
 Client Stabilization.



 Client stabilization is still ongoing. We apologize to everyone who can't play the game yet. We'll upload the future plans in Discussions. Please refer to that.

 - PiedPipers Team.

notes.title: Patch Notes (1.48 ver.)
notes.notes:
Here’s our 1.48 ver. patch notes.



 Doesn't rebel if there's no target general.
 Bottom of the window is not cutting down anymore.
 Outlaws returns in 3 -> 6 months.
 Unabled to attack due to order of attack and defense is fixed.
 Log message is fixed to find more bugs.
 Client stabilization



 We have some users that cannot play the game yet, so our first target is to make client stabilized. If the error or the message named ScriptError pops up, please click Yes to open our Report webpage, and follow the guidance there. We'll solve the problem quickly.


Plebby Quest is using Steam Cloud system for savings. Some of you are having problems losing save files. So, we're agonizing to turn this function off. If you're having this problem now, please go to Properties... -> UPDATES -> Turn off the checkbox in Steam Cloud. 


 - PiedPipers Team

notes.title: Patch Notes (1.47 ver.)
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35393732/21e281052ec3f705c0c87a8eea61f28bbdd59bd7.jpg

Here’s our 1.47 ver. patch notes.

 Client stabilization


 If you proceed the game without updating, problems could occur. So, please do this update and proceed your game.

 If a strange phenomenon occurred already, that save file cannot be restored. We truly apologize to everyone those who player for a long turn. Please return to your save file before the problem occurred.


 - With an apologetic heart, PiedPipers Team
